title: Polynomial-time counting loop
statement: The function that starts with the pair encoding of the empty word and an input word, then iterates the following update one more than the input length, is polynomial-time computable: if the second projection is empty, leave the pair unchanged; otherwise, replace it by the pair encoding of the sum of the decoded first projection and the one-bit word $[1]$, together with the second projection after its first bit is removed.
